opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, Bram speaking.
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com.
verification.comment: You changed account data without first confirming the caller's full name plus order number or postcode, so verification was skipped before the change.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi brown. I'd like to change the email address on my account, I don't use the old one any more.
understanding.comment: You captured the email change request and asked only for the new address, without repeating questions the caller had already answered.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, your lamp shipped this morning and and arrives in 3 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Standard delivery is 2 to 4 working days, so saying 3 to 4 is not a stated policy figure; quote the policy range accurately and avoid guessing the timeline.

process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo/voucher steps applied here, so this criterion is met.

communication.comment: The caller was not frustrated, but the reply was curt; a warmer, more polite tone such as thanking the caller would be better.

closing.comment: You did not confirm what happens next or ask if there was anything else, so the call ended abruptly without a proper close.
